definitions.explanation: The hollow area under the arm where it joins the body. Used in everyday, medical, and hygiene contexts.

examples.japanese: {脇|わき}の{下|した}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{体温|たいおん}→体温：03385_taion⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測|はか}る→測る：01977_hakaru⟧。
examples.english: To take one's temperature under the armpit.

examples.japanese: {脇|わき}の{下|した}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{体温計|たいおんけい}→体温計：05484_taionkei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挟|はさ}んで→挟む：00091_hasamu⟧⟦{五分|ごふん}→五分：09573_gofun⟧⟦{待|ま}って→待つ：00469_matsu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please place the thermometer under your arm and wait five minutes.

notes: In Japan, the standard way to measure body temperature is under the armpit ({脇|わき}の{下|した}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{測|はか}る→測る：01977_hakaru⟧), unlike in some Western countries where oral thermometers are common. Common collocations: {脇|わき}の{下|した}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{汗|あせ}をかく→汗をかく：16925_asewokaku⟧ (to sweat under the arms), {脇|わき}の{下|した}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挟|はさ}む→挟む：00091_hasamu⟧ (to hold under the arm). Also written as {腋|わき}の{下|した} with a different kanji. Sometimes shortened to simply ⟦{脇|わき}→脇：03790_waki⟧ in casual speech.
